query: What respirometry acceptance criteria will we enforce (maximum biopsy→assay delay, cytochrome c increase threshold, within-sample replicate CV) and how will failed assays be handled statistically?

response.query: What respirometry acceptance criteria will we enforce (maximum biopsy→assay delay, cytochrome c increase threshold, within-sample replicate CV) and how will failed assays be handled statistically?
response.answer: Acceptance criteria include a maximum 30-minute biopsy-to-assay delay, a cytochrome c increase threshold of 15%, and a within-sample replicate CV ≤ 10%. Failed assays are re-run; if still failed, they are excluded from analysis.
